-- TEMP TABLE FOR "diagnosed with diabetes"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_type_ii_diabetes;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_type_ii_diabetes AS
SELECT person_id, "type_ii_diabetes" AS "type_ii_diabetes"
FROM aireadi.condition_occurrence;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_type_ii_diabetes ON temp_master_type_ii_diabetes (person_id);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "hemoglobin (g/dl)", "hemoglobin (g/dl)", "hemoglobin (g/dl)"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl AS
SELECT person_id, "hemoglobin_g_dl" AS "hemoglobin_g_dl"
FROM aireadi.measurement;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl ON temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl (person_id);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "4 level retinopathy severity worse eye", "4 level retinopathy severity worse eye"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes AS
SELECT person_id, "diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes" AS "diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes"
FROM aireadi.condition_occurrence;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes ON temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes (person_id);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "age", "sex"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_age;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_age AS
SELECT person_id, "age" AS "age"
FROM aireadi.participants;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_age ON temp_master_age (person_id);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "race", "race"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_you_are_treated_with_less_respect_than_other_people;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_you_are_treated_with_less_respect_than_other_people AS
SELECT person_id, "you_are_treated_with_less_respect_than_other_people" AS "you_are_treated_with_less_respect_than_other_people"
FROM aireadi.observation;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_you_are_treated_with_less_respect_than_other_people ON temp_master_you_are_treated_with_less_respect_than_other_people (person_id);

-- ALL UNIQUE PATIENT IDs
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_all_ids;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_all_ids AS
SELECT person_id FROM temp_master_type_ii_diabetes
UNION
SELECT person_id FROM temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl
UNION
SELECT person_id FROM temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes
UNION
SELECT person_id FROM temp_master_age
UNION
SELECT person_id FROM temp_master_you_are_treated_with_less_respect_than_other_people;

-- Add index to the main ID table for the final join
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_all_ids_person_id ON temp_all_ids (person_id);

-- FINAL MASTER TABLE
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS final_master_table;
CREATE TABLE final_master_table AS
SELECT
    a.person_id,
    t0."type_ii_diabetes",
    t1."hemoglobin_g_dl",
    t2."diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes",
    t3."age",
    t4."you_are_treated_with_less_respect_than_other_people"
FROM temp_all_ids a
LEFT JOIN temp_master_type_ii_diabetes t0 ON a.person_id = t0.person_id 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_hemoglobin_g_dl t1 ON a.person_id = t1.person_id 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes t2 ON a.person_id = t2.person_id 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_age t3 ON a.person_id = t3.person_id 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_you_are_treated_with_less_respect_than_other_people t4 ON a.person_id = t4.person_id;

CREATE INDEX idx_final_master_person_id    
    ON final_master_table (person_id);
-- ========== STEP 1: Inclusion ==========

-- STEP 1.1: Includes all patients diagnosed with diabetes
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step1 AS
SELECT "person_id"
FROM final_master_table
WHERE "type_ii_diabetes" = 'Yes';

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude patients with missing hemoglobin (g/dl)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."person_id"
FROM temp_inclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."person_id" = f."person_id"
WHERE f."hemoglobin_g_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude patients with missing 4 level retinopathy severity worse eye
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."person_id"
FROM temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."person_id" = f."person_id"
WHERE f."diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes" IS NOT NULL;

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "person_id"
FROM temp_exclusion_step2;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Age
-- Extract age for the cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_age AS
SELECT c."person_id", f."age"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."person_id" = f."person_id";

-- 4.2 Sex
-- Extract sex (using 'age' column as per schema definition, which appears to be a schema error)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_sex AS
SELECT c."person_id", f."age" AS "sex" -- Schema indicates 'age' column for 'sex' covariate. This might be a schema error.
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."person_id" = f."person_id";

-- 4.3 Race
-- Create race variable. The schema provides labels but no mapping logic from the source column
-- 'you_are_treated_with_less_respect_than_other_people' to these race categories.
-- Therefore, this variable cannot be derived as specified and will be NULL.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_race AS
SELECT c."person_id",
       NULL::TEXT AS "race" -- Mapping logic for race is missing in the schema.
FROM temp_cohort c;

-- 4.4 Hemoglobin (g/dl)
-- Extract raw hemoglobin values for the cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_hemoglobin_raw AS
SELECT c."person_id", f."hemoglobin_g_dl"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."person_id" = f."person_id";

-- Calculate tertile cutoffs for hemoglobin within cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_hemoglobin_cutoffs AS
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.33) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "hemoglobin_g_dl") AS tertile1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.66) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "hemoglobin_g_dl") AS tertile2
FROM temp_hemoglobin_raw;

-- Assign patients to hemoglobin tertile groups
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_hemoglobin_tertiles AS
SELECT "person_id",
  CASE
    WHEN "hemoglobin_g_dl" IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN "hemoglobin_g_dl" <= (SELECT tertile1 FROM temp_hemoglobin_cutoffs) THEN 'T1: <=33rd percentile'
    WHEN "hemoglobin_g_dl" <= (SELECT tertile2 FROM temp_hemoglobin_cutoffs) THEN 'T2: >33rd percentile and <=66th percentile'
    ELSE 'T3: >66th percentile'
  END AS "hemoglobin_g_dl"
FROM temp_hemoglobin_raw;

-- 4.5 Retinopathy
-- Map 4 level retinopathy severity worse eye to binary outcome (1 or 0)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_retinopathy AS
SELECT c."person_id",
  CASE
    WHEN f."diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes" = 'Yes' THEN 1
    WHEN f."diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes" = 'No' THEN 0
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "retinopathy"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."person_id" = f."person_id";

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
  c."person_id",
  a."age",
  s."sex",
  r."race",
  h."hemoglobin_g_dl",
  o."retinopathy"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN temp_age a ON c."person_id" = a."person_id"
JOIN temp_sex s ON c."person_id" = s."person_id"
JOIN temp_race r ON c."person_id" = r."person_id"
JOIN temp_hemoglobin_tertiles h ON c."person_id" = h."person_id"
JOIN temp_retinopathy o ON c."person_id" = o."person_id";
